_: The map builder's palette: every prop an author can place, by category, and the model it is drawn with (the pack zip in lanorim/assets and the file inside it; tools/pull-models.ps1 brings them into game/). 'blocks' marks a prop the board treats as filling its square. 'retired' (cc_task_m3) takes a prop off the builder's pickers; a map that has one still loads and draws it, so nothing is ever removed from here.
